patch.title: 统一问卷 Q1 表述使其与 Q2 平行，并将 methods 中的题号（Q1/Q2）与两类五级量表描述同步至问卷内容

hunks.newText: Q1. How satisfied are you with the service?

hunks.oldText: We used a five-level scale and analyzed Question 1 and Question 2.
hunks.newText: We used two five-level scales: a satisfaction scale for Q1 (1 = Very dissatisfied to 5 = Very satisfied) and a recommendation likelihood scale for Q2 (1 = Definitely no to 5 = Definitely yes), and analyzed both Q1 and Q2.
